info.title: BuildQuickPkg - Interactive ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture CLI Scaffolder
info.description: An interactive .NET global tool that scaffolds a production-ready Clean Architecture ASP.NET Core solution (3-Layer or 4-Layer, Minimal API or Controllers) in seconds. Supports Monolithic and Microservice styles, with optional Entity Framework Core (PostgreSQL/SQL Server), a generic Repository/UnitOfWork pattern, JWT authentication, Docker, a Caddy reverse proxy, and .env generation, all addable later via "BuildQuickPkg add" without regenerating the project. Ships with Serilog structured logging and pre-configured xUnit integration tests out of the box.
